title: Atalaya Vacation Home
description: Welcome to Atalaya House!Perched in the mountains, this 3,400 sq ft home offers breathtaking views and a true Puerto Rican experience. Enjoy a private infinity pool overlooking the island’s west side, nearly 2 acres of land, and a garden with fruit trees and tropical flowers. Perfect for families and groups, with 4 bedrooms accommodating up to 16 guests.The space•• First Floor ••As you walk in, you’re welcomed by a bright open-concept space surrounded by windows, allowing you to enjoy breathtaking views from almost every angle. It’s a relaxed, airy space perfect for gathering. You’ll also find a ping pong table and games to enjoy with family and friends.•• Kitchens ••The home features 2 kitchens. The main kitchen is fully equipped for cooking full meals, while the upstairs kitchen is perfect for snacks, coffee, or drinks without having to go downstairs.•• Bedroom #1 ••Located on the first floor, this room features a king-size bed. While it does not have A/C, it stays cool thanks to its location and ceiling fan.•• Bedroom #2 ••Also on the first floor, this room includes 2 full-size beds and A/C. It shares a bathroom with Bedroom #1, with a separate vanity area for added convenience. Both rooms are wheelchair accessible.•• Bedroom #3 ••Upstairs, this room is perfect for groups or kids. It features 3 bunk beds (6 twin beds), A/C, and a private full bathroom.•• Bedroom #4 ••The spacious master bedroom includes a king-size bed and 2 twin beds (one pull-out). It offers A/C, a private bathroom, and a terrace with stunning views—perfect for morning coffee or unwinding at sunset.•• Game / TV Area ••A cozy upstairs space with reclining chairs, bean bags, an 80” smart TV, and a second kitchen—perfect for relaxing after a day out.•• View Room ••A special spot at the top of the stairs where you can enjoy coffee, great conversation, and panoramic views of the ocean and mountains—even sunrise views.•• Pool ••The highlight of the home. Enjoy the infinity pool with open views, a dining area, propane grill, and plenty of seating. Perfect for daytime fun or evening swims with color-changing lights.⸻✨ Atalaya House isn’t about luxury—it’s about space, comfort, and an authentic Puerto Rican mountain experience, surrounded by nature, fresh air, and unforgettable views.Guest accessEntire HouseOther things to note> Things to consider <•• Location •• The house is located on the top of the mountain, this is the reason why the view is so amazing and you can enjoy privacy and peace. The road to get there is a whole experience that will allow you to immerse into the Puerto Rican culture better than the tourist areas do. It could be a little bit difficult if you are not used to drive on steep and narrow streets. We would provide the best routes so you can get there safely. •• Extra Guests •• The house is ready for up to 16 guests. However, if you would like to have additional guests for an additional fee, we can set up 2 queen-sized air mattresses in the game room or view room. There will also be extra sheets and pillows.••Parties and events•• Parties are not allowed at the property without the host permission. If you are thinking about the possibility to host an event/party while your stay please refer to us so we can guide you through the process to do so.Any party or event that takes place without our consent will be subject to a fine.•• Towels ••We provide bathroom towels for each guest and a few beach/pool towels as a courtesy of the house.•• Backup system •• We have a generator and water cistern that serve as a backup in case the power or water goes out. •• Pets Allowance •• If you are thinking of sharing this experience with your pet, please contact us in advance. We do allow small, trained pets for an extra cleaning fee. Fill out a form and pay a deposit upfront will be required. Do not hesitate to contact us for more information. •• Puerto Rico is a place with rainforest weather, as well as flora and fauna. We do our best efforts to protect the house from insects or lizards, but it’s hard to guarantee you will not see them around the house (inside or outside). •• We provide free parking in the driveway for 4-5 cars.

title: Casa Al Mare #1 / 3 minutes walk to Sandy Beach
description: Relax and enjoy your vacation at this comfortable beach apartment located at walking distance to Sandy Beach and bars and restaurants at Puntas Ward, Rincon. This unit features two bedrooms (Queen size beds) and one full bathroom. Both bedrooms have air conditioning. Fully equipped kitchen, living area and covered terrace. Free designated parking is provided for one car.The spaceThe accommodationOur upper-floor unit offers two beautifully furnished bedrooms and one bathroom. Enjoy the tropical breeze and impressive views from your own private balcony—the perfect place to relax after a day at the beach. The accommodation is fully furnished and equipped with all the amenities you need for a hassle-free vacation, including WiFi, TV, air conditioning in the bedrooms, and a fully equipped kitchen. We also provide beach towels for your convenience.Guest accessYou'll have off-street parking for a car, but you won't hesitate to explore the popular Puntas neighborhood on foot. With fantastic beaches for surfing (Sandy Beach and Pool's Beach) and some of the best restaurants in the area just a few steps away ( Tamboo Bar and Rest, Casa Verde and Red Flamboyan Restaurant) , our location is ideal for families and friends traveling together. Each guest can have their own space and privacy while still being close to all the action.

title: Stunning seaside getaway, ocean views, Rincón
description: Peaceful, private oceanfront suite with a spacious bedroom, fully equipped kitchen, comfortable dining area and bathroom. Enjoy stunning views and outdoor lounge areas alongside the Rincon seascape in a centrally located, quiet and safe neighborhood. This property offers some of the best sunrise and sunset views available on the western side of Puerto Rico! Be within minutes from the best restaurants, night life, shopping, beaches, and other unique cultural activities.The spaceThis guest suite is a bright, light-filled space with gorgeous ocean views from every room! The kitchen offers a stove, oven, full-sized fridge and freezer, and all cook-ready essentials. There is a spacious indoor and outdoor dining area. The bedroom has a queen sized bed, electronic privacy window shades, and an amazing view of the ocean. The bathroom has a step-in shower. Outdoor lounge space faces the seascape. All bed linens, bath and beach towels are provided for your stay. All bathroom essentials are included.Guest accessGuests have access to the entire space.Other things to noteGuests are staying in a private suite (attached to a larger home) with its own entrance and parking space. There is no shared or common spaces.

description: Steps from Rincon's plaza, top-rated restaurants, craft brewery, farmers market & Thursday art walk. Beach in 10 min on foot.The full first floor of a downtown property — 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, 2 kitchens & individual A/C per room. Sleeps 8 across 4 full beds and 2 twins. Plenty of space for large families, reunions & friend groups who want room to spread out.Three (3) Smart TVs. High-speed WiFi. Self check-in. Pets welcome for a fee. Free street parking.The spaceAbove the Plaza 5 is the entire first floor — the most spacious option in the building and one of the best-located rentals in downtown Rincon. Your group gets the full floor to yourselves, with no shared spaces and complete privacy throughout your stay.The unit sleeps 8 across three bedrooms: one room with a full bed, one room with two twin beds, and a private back studio with its own full bed and kitchenette. Three private bathrooms mean plenty of room for everyone to get ready without the wait. The main kitchen is fully equipped with cookware, dinnerware, appliances, and everything you need to cook in. A second kitchenette in the back studio adds even more flexibility. Every room has its own individual A/C unit. Three flat-screen Smart TVs and high-speed WiFi are available throughout.This is the ideal choice for large families, friend groups, reunions, and multi-generational trips that want to stay together under one roof in Rincon's most walkable address. Two minutes to the plaza, five of TripAdvisor's top-rated restaurants, the weekly farmers market, and the Thursday art walk. The beach is ten minutes on foot.The whole floor is yours. Make it your own.Guest accessAbove the Plaza 5 is entirely yours — the complete first floor with no shared spaces and no interruptions. Every room, both kitchens, all three bathrooms, and the back studio are yours for the duration of your stay.This is the ideal setup for groups who want to stay together with plenty of room to spread out. Cook together, watch different shows in different rooms, or simply enjoy having an entire floor in the heart of Rincon to call your own.Other things to noteA note on noise: the house sits on Rincon's main road, so you may occasionally hear passing traffic. In our experience guests find it easy to tune out — but we'd rather you know upfront than be surprised. The covered terrace in the back is your quiet escape when you want it.What you won't hear is Plaza noise. Despite being two minutes away on foot, the house sits just far enough from the action that evenings stay peaceful — the best of both worlds.

description: Coconut Cottage is a private two-bedroom serene getaway . Our home offers whimsical charm on a hillside surrounded by palm trees and gorgeous ocean vistas. There is a short 3 minute walk to Pools and Sandy Beach. We are located in Barrio puntas featuring outstanding restaurants within walking distance. Rincon town center or the Pueblo is a 10 minute drive. For those looking to embrace slow living with a dose of wanderlust, we invite you to our home!The spaceOur home, a unique creation hand-built and designed by the owner, is a testament to our love of Puerto Rico, which we take pride in sharing with our guests.Our first-floor laundry room is located by the carport. We offer a full washer and dryer. You will also find your beach essentials—chairs, umbrellas, coolers , snorkel gear, and boogie boards. After a day at the beach, our outdoor shower is a refreshing way to wash off the sand.The second-story wraparound deck is a delightful outdoor space. You can enjoy dining, relaxing, watching the sun, moon gaze over the ocean, and simply slow down. Step inside to the open kitchen and living room, which have vaulted ceilings and are flanked by three windows, providing incredible natural light. The kitchen is fully equipped, and the pantry has many cooking essentials. There is spacious dining for four. Both bedrooms are air-conditioned with ceiling fans and comfortable queen-size beds. There is air conditioning in the main living space as well. We offer one full bathroom and an outdoor shower. The living room has an eclectic blend of comfortable seating, with Wifi and a flat-screen TV. The library offers a wide array of reading books, local guidebooks, and board games. Hand-painted driftwood and sea beach-found art pieces from past guests and local artists tastefully adorn the cottage. With our art supplies, you can find your creative muse and relax. From the third-floor balcony, enjoy sweeping ocean views, relaxing sea breezes, and the sounds of lush tropical fauna. This space is perched high with the best ocean panoramic views from the cottage—a divine space for morning yoga, sunbathing, and moonlit evenings.Guest accessThe entire house with private parking.Other things to noteTo enter the cottage, you will have to walk up a set of stairs. The decks and inside stairs case are a safety issue for small children. Therefore, we do not accommodate children under the age 10.We have a full house generator and ample water reserves.
